ex800 emulator version 1.0.0
----------------------------

ex800 is a free and portable Atari 8-bit computer emulator based on Atari800
7.2.1. Atari 5200 support has been removed. Atari800 was originally written by
David Firth and is developed by the Atari800 Development Team (please see
DOC/CREDITS). This program is copyrighted and released under the GPL (see
COPYING).

Please read DOC/README, DOC/INSTALL and DOC/USAGE and eventual platform
specific versions of the above mentioned files.

For news in this release please read DOC/NEWS.

If you have a problem running this emulator please read DOC/FAQ first.
If the problem persists then please ask in newsgroup comp.sys.atari.8bit
or in the atari800-users mailing list (see below).

Look at DOC/BUGS before reporting something you consider a bug.

For information about the upstream project, see its homepage below.

Upstream project homepage: https://atari800.github.io/
